domain.gap_definition: Ball-bottom release Z minus board-center Z; ball center adds radius

sweep.sobol: Independent scrambled five-dimensional sequence per seed/TRAIN coordinate; 30-bit bin midpoints avoid infinite inverse transforms
sweep.prediction: Nearest TRAIN coordinate, stable ID tie-break; transfer its best observed latent residual relative to the shared geometry prior; no inference-time search

protocol.initial_prior: Unchanged ContinuousPolicy geometry prior; no old weights, shot labels, map anchors or exact-context lookup
protocol.sample_definition: Every requested TRAIN action including IK, clearance, path and settling rejects; no free retries or replacements
protocol.schedule: Paired seeded permutation of all 35 TRAIN sites per logical round; exact milestone cuts split a round without spending future attempts

evaluation.selection: Final 10000-attempt artifact only; validation is diagnostic and never selects/replaces a checkpoint
evaluation.test: Final frozen deterministic prediction once at each of 70 unseen coordinates; no shot search, outcome query, retry or adaptation

protocol.scope: Single fixed ball; three paired seeds; privileged geometry; one terminal cooperative shot decision. Native travel/grasp and material adaptation are not learned.

reward.first_external_step: 1-based relative scoring sample; that sample and all later samples excluded from shaping
reward.prefix: Unchanged ShotScore state after qualified board bounce, strictly before first external force >0.01N; no global closest/retention fallback
reward.distance_geometry: Unchanged ShotScore.closest: Euclidean ball-center distance to bucket center XY at Z=top minus ball radius, capped by its historical 2m initialization; not an aperture-clearance measurement
reward.capture: Unchanged board bounce + whole-ball entry + continuous one second inside + BoardRoute without external contact; rim-assisted captures count
reward.scope: Terminal training reward only. Capture labels, physics, material assumptions and historical returns are not changed.

limits: Final PPO is unfinished; this is an interim evidence package with no across-method winner.
All rejects consume the paid TRAIN budget; exploratory TRAIN success is separate from frozen direct inference.
Final TEST uses the prescribed final10000-request artifact once at each of70 unseen positions, without shot search, retry, adaptation or validation-based selection.
The same70 TEST coordinates are shared across methods and training seeds; repeated seeds are not independent new positions.
Single fixed ball, privileged geometry, scripted joint travel and initialized release; no learned grasp/motor control, perception or physical validation.
175mm reported bucket-height interpretation, fixed material parameters and rigid board mount remain provisional.

TRAIN wall excludes evaluation; headless/render episode phases include evaluation and exclude outside learner overhead. Lifetime RSS and sampled whole-device GPU occupancy are not isolated phase peaks or policy-only memory.
Sweep loader guards protocol, action domain and TRAIN membership; geometry compatibility is bound externally through source and audit identities.
